name: meeting-prep
description: To start: connect your calendar and say 'set up meeting prep' — it learns what you're working on from your own activity. Then say 'prep my meetings' anytime, or put it on a schedule. It researches every upcoming meeting with someone new — who they are, why you're meeting, what to ask — and leaves a private prep note on your calendar so you're never walking in cold. Keeps itself up to date; never touches your real meetings.
